note: SPEC vectors for Hoare-checked composition of Enzyme pathways: post(A) ⊨ guard(B), with the composite's guard, effect and emission all derived. Authored from the article, not generated from the reference engine.

divergence.statement: The reference engine has no compose-time check of any kind. It chains Enzymes DYNAMICALLY — OperativeGraph.run walks a node graph at execution time, and simulate.run_path steps a fork — so an illegal chain is discovered by running it and watching a later step refuse. There is no `entails`, no `wp`, no notion of post(A) ⊨ guard(B); the only `compose` in the tree is curated_ui.compose, which is the unrelated UI view-composer.
divergence.what_python_does_have_and_why_it_is_not_: OperativeGraph DOES validate at load time that every node names an operator present in OPERATOR_REGISTRY, and it carries a max_steps cycle guard. Both are real and worth not erasing — but they check that a step EXISTS, not that a step can FOLLOW the one before it. A graph whose every node resolves and whose third node's guard can never be satisfied loads clean and fails at run time, which is exactly the discovery this slice moves earlier.
divergence.the_undecided_region_is_shared_not_a_gap: Neither engine decides entailment in general — it is undecidable (Church, 1936). The difference is that Rust now returns a three-valued verdict and carries `runtime_guard_required` when it cannot prove the implication, where Python has no verdict at all. An SMT solver would shrink the undecided region and is deliberately not pulled in; a dependency-free core is what lets this crate ship to a phone.
divergence.when_python_catches_up: These cases become parity vectors unchanged; nothing in them is Rust-specific.
divergence.not_a_divergence_in: R1 behaviour. Composition is a new, additive module and touches no existing gate path.

entailment_cases.name: a_stronger_post_entails_a_weaker_guard
entailment_cases.why: The ordinary admissible chain: leaving the balance at or above 100 establishes 'at or above 50'.

entailment_cases.name: a_weaker_post_is_undecided_not_refuted
entailment_cases.why: The distinction the three-valued verdict exists for. A balance of 100 satisfies both, so the chain CAN run — it just is not proven to. Reporting this as refuted would reject a chain that works.

entailment_cases.name: disjoint_intervals_are_refuted_because_the_chain_can_never_run
entailment_cases.why: Refuted is the STRONGER claim: post ∧ guard is unsatisfiable, so no state satisfies both. That is what licenses refusing to build the chain at all rather than merely warning about it.

entailment_cases.name: touching_at_a_closed_boundary_is_not_refuted
entailment_cases.why: post: x <= 0, guard: x >= 0. The single point x = 0 satisfies both, so the chain can run and must not be rejected. Off-by-one on interval openness would silently break working recipes.

entailment_cases.name: an_open_boundary_that_only_touches_is_refuted
entailment_cases.why: post: x < 0, guard: x >= 0. Now nothing satisfies both. The pair of cases pins the boundary arithmetic exactly.

entailment_cases.name: a_conjunction_narrows_the_interval
entailment_cases.why: Conjunctions of interval constraints are the decidable fragment, so an AND of bounds must intersect rather than be taken one at a time.

entailment_cases.name: an_empty_guard_is_established_by_anything
entailment_cases.why: Nothing is required, so nothing needs establishing. skip is the identity of the algebra.

fragment_boundary_cases.name: disjunction_is_undecided
fragment_boundary_cases.why: Outside the decidable fragment. The rule is that anything outside it is reported undecided and NEVER guessed — a false 'entailed' would let a broken chain save, and a false 'refuted' would reject a working one.

fragment_boundary_cases.name: quantifiers_are_undecided
fragment_boundary_cases.why: Bounded quantifiers are in the LANGUAGE but not in this slice's decidable fragment. Honest about which.

fragment_boundary_cases.name: not_equal_is_undecided_because_it_is_not_an_interval
fragment_boundary_cases.why: '!=' punches a hole in the line, which is not an interval — so it falls outside the fragment rather than being approximated.

fragment_boundary_cases.name: a_param_comparison_is_undecided
fragment_boundary_cases.why: params are not known at compose time. This is precisely a runtime obligation, and is carried as one.

wp_cases.name: wp_through_an_untouched_path_is_the_guard_itself
wp_cases.why: The common case: A and B touch different parts of state, so B's guard passes through unchanged. This is what makes wp computable at all in a core where effects are opaque functions.

wp_cases.name: wp_through_a_shift_moves_the_literal
wp_cases.why: balance' = balance − 30, so (balance' >= 50) ⟺ (balance >= 80). The pullback stays a comparison, so it stays inside the fragment and needs no arithmetic the language does not have.

wp_cases.name: wp_through_a_set_constant_folds_to_always
wp_cases.why: If A sets the value, the guard's truth is decided at compose time.

wp_cases.name: wp_through_a_set_constant_folds_to_never
wp_cases.why: The other half — and this is what turns a chain from undecided into refused.

wp_cases.name: wp_through_an_opaque_change_is_reported_not_guessed
wp_cases.why: A change by a param cannot be pulled back — the language has no arithmetic, so 'balance − params.amount >= k' is not expressible. Inventing a weakest precondition for an effect nobody described would be a false claim about when the chain is safe.

compose_cases.name: a_valid_chain_composes_with_every_part_derived
compose_cases.why: ε_{A;B} = ε_A · ε_B in order, cost is the sum of the parts, and post(A;B) = post(B). Nothing about the composite is declared; all of it is derived.

compose_cases.name: a_refuted_chain_yields_no_composite_at_all
compose_cases.why: The structural form of 'a recipe whose third step can never fire should be impossible to save': compose returns Result, so there is no Composed value to hold for a dead chain.

compose_cases.name: an_undecided_chain_composes_but_carries_the_runtime_guard
compose_cases.why: The third verdict, honoured: compose, but say so. Silently composing without the flag would be a false claim of proof.

compose_cases.name: no_effect_summary_means_the_next_guard_stays_a_runtime_obligation
compose_cases.why: wp needs to know what A does. Where A declares nothing, B's guard is carried rather than claimed discharged — even when ⊨ itself was entailed.

compose_cases.name: a_declared_effect_that_touches_nothing_relevant_discharges_the_guard
compose_cases.why: Entailed AND wp computable: the composite needs no runtime check, and says so by leaving the flag clear.

compose_cases.name: wp_puts_the_pulled_back_guard_into_the_composite
compose_cases.why: g_{A;B} = g_A ∧ wp(e_A, g_B). Spending 30 then requiring 50 means requiring 80 up front — which is a fact about the chain that neither step states on its own.

compose_cases.name: a_set_that_can_never_satisfy_the_next_guard_rejects_the_chain
compose_cases.why: wp reaching `never` is a second, independent route to rejection — the entailment check alone would have said undecided here, because A declares no post at all.

algebra_cases.name: chaining_is_associative
algebra_cases.why: Function composition is associative and E* is a free monoid, so (A;B);C and A;(B;C) must agree. The article calls this the one concrete thing the categorical reading earns — so it is checked, not assumed.

pathway_cases.name: a_good_pathway_saves_and_carries_the_whole_chain
pathway_cases.why: The end-to-end shape a stored recipe takes.

pathway_cases.name: a_pathway_cannot_be_built_around_a_refuted_link
pathway_cases.why: THE headline property. A Pathway has no constructor that takes steps on trust, so holding one means every link was checked — a broken recipe is not rejected on save, it cannot be held.

pathway_cases.name: an_empty_pathway_is_refused
pathway_cases.why: There is no identity recipe to save.

pathway_cases.name: a_single_step_is_a_pathway
pathway_cases.why: The base case of the fold.
